newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW might clear NFIs for trade on April 3.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW might clear NFIs for trade on April 3.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) might clear for public trade National Investment Funds (NFIs) in the country's mass privatisation scheme at a session due on April 3, the KPW's spokeswoman said.
"Most probably on Thursday, April 3, the commission will examine the issue prospectuses of the National Investment Funds," Beata Stelmach told a news conference on Friday.
Under the government's NFI programme, shares in some 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to 15 NFIs run by foreign and domestic management firms.
The 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit in the scheme will have the opportunity to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund, which are expected to start bourse trade around mid-year.
Stelmach also said 13 unlisted firms and three listed firms had issue prospectuses currently with the KPW.
